plugin.note: Choose the private solo or public group form. Rat bone weapons improve combat training and clear summoned rats quickly; all three combat styles have dedicated preparations.

requirements: The lair has no quest or Slayer-level gate. The Wiki recommends combat stats around 50 and 43 Prayer for the protection-prayer preparations.
Equipment levels, complete-set conditions, selected spellbook and weapon charge preparation are checked separately.
mechanics: The private solo form has 500 Hitpoints and combat level 200; the public group form has 1,500 Hitpoints and combat level 250. Both count for Rat assignments.
Phase one starts with melee attacks and occasional falling bricks. At 80% health Scurrius moves to a food pile and breaks binds.

Phase two alternates feeding and ordinary combat. Ten eating animations contain five healing events, each restoring 5 or 10 Hitpoints per player. During feeding Scurrius uses ranged and magic, without melee.
At 30% health (150 solo or 450 group), phase three moves to the centre, accelerates ranged and magic attacks, and removes melee attacks. Healing above 30% returns the encounter to phase two.
Tail Swipe is the fastest and most accurate basic attack. The matching protection prayer negates each basic attack; ranged and magic damage is checked on impact.
Falling Bricks targets the player position at initiation plus random ground positions; damage is 15-22 solo or 15-24 group. Repeated casts can occur in phase three.
Minion waves contain six level-46 giant rats. Any hit kills one; their melee attacks can still deal 0-1 through protection, or up to 4 without it. Phase three can summon up to 12 waves.
Rat bone weapons have no attack delay between summoned-rat attacks. An attack on the boss followed by a minion still incurs the normal boss-attack delay.

The source weapon row is split into powered-staff, standard-spell and Ancient-Magicks preparations so each spellbook and rune plan is explicit. Magic potions chiefly improve accuracy for cast spells, but may increase a powered staff maximum hit.

The source harmonised staff alternative is normalized to 500 Wind Surge casts: one wrath and seven air runes each. Wind Surge is available at 81 Magic; staff equip eligibility is checked separately. Its maximum hit scales up to the level-95 surge tier.
Solo guarantees the MVP damage role and uses the weaker private form.

Zaryte crossbow is an optional special switch even in magic armour; it requires the matching ruby-bolt switch and is most useful early in a kill. Accursed sceptre is the alternative for a small defence reduction.

Cannons are prohibited; this encounter is not a safespot.

methods.label: Access, instances and returning after death
methods.summary: Scurrius is east of the Varrock Sewers entrance; the private instance is free.
steps: The sewer manhole is east of Varrock Palace. Broken bars lead into either the public arena or a private instance.
Leaving through the sewage water starts an approximately 15-second re-entry delay.
Graves appear beside Historian Aldo outside the lair. Fires and dwarf multicannons cannot be set up inside.

methods.label: Summoned giant rats and weapon alternatives
methods.summary: The level-46 summoned rats count for Rat tasks but only appear as encounter adds.
steps: A wave contains six rats and any attack kills one. Bone mace, bone shortbow and charged bone staff allow attacks on successive minions without cooldown.
Without a rat bone weapon, the Wiki alternatives are a charged Venator bow, Rune thrownaxe special or Dinh's bulwark special. Bronze knives or darts are inexpensive fast switches.
A Venator-bow switch also needs compatible arrows. The ranged special alternatives are optional equipment choices, not mandatory switches for every method.
Without those weapons, the boss and existing rats can obstruct additional minions. Protect from Melee reduces, but does not eliminate, rat damage.
Minions persist after the boss dies and may prevent food-pile healing. Attacking the boss before switching to a rat retains the ordinary boss-attack delay.

methods.label: Food piles, consumables and trip length
methods.summary: Food piles restore full health once every ten minutes while out of combat.
steps: A short period without being attacked is required; surviving minions can interrupt it even after Scurrius dies.
Use more food while learning; replace food with prayer restoration as avoidable damage falls.
Melee can use normal or divine super combat potions, or separate attack/strength/defence boosts. Ranged can use normal/divine ranging, with bastion alternatives for Defence.
High-level magic can use a saturated heart or forgotten brews; brews reduce Defence and may require extra restores.
Prayer potions, super restores and food or Saradomin brews are the sustain options. Holy wrench or a Prayer cape improves prayer restoration.
Keep a suitable teleport available. High-level examples use a house tablet; a Max cape is an alternative.

methods.label: Alchemy and Varrock Teleport preparation
methods.summary: The mid-level examples reserve runes for optional standard-spellbook utility spells.
steps: High Level Alchemy needs 55 Magic and one nature plus five fire runes per cast; budget 100 nature and 500 fire for 100 casts.
Varrock Teleport needs 25 Magic and one law, one fire and three air runes per cast.
A rune pouch can save inventory space; an equipped elemental staff can replace its element. Reserve extra runes beyond the combat spell plan.
These standard spells cannot be used from Ancient Magicks or Arceuus. Carry a teleport item when using those spellbooks.

methods.label: Optional thralls and Death Charge
methods.summary: High-level examples include Book of the Dead and Arceuus runes for support spells.
steps: A Kingdom Divided and the Arceuus spellbook are required. Resurrect Greater Ghost needs 76 Magic, six prayer points and Book of the Dead equipped or carried.
Each greater-ghost cast consumes ten fire, five blood and one cosmic rune. Ten casts need 100 fire, 50 blood and ten cosmic runes.
Death Charge needs 80 Magic and one death, one blood and one soul rune per cast. Ten casts need ten of each rune.

The source divine-pouch example uses fire, blood, aether and death runes. Aether substitutes for cosmic and soul: ten thralls plus ten Death Charges need 100 fire, 60 blood, 20 aether and ten death runes.
Book of the Dead is mandatory for thralls. Support spells are optional and use their own rune quantities; they are not included in ordinary combat staff charge estimates.
Ancient-Magicks Blood Barrage and standard-spell setups use their own spellbooks and cannot use these Arceuus support spells simultaneously.

methods.label: Feeding phase and reduced switching alternative
methods.summary: Ranged or magic users can choose a lower-switching approach during feeding, with more damage risk.
steps: During feeding, Scurrius does not use melee. The Wiki lower-switching alternative protects against the style that the equipped armour defends least effectively against.
The usual preparation uses Protect from Melee before phase three and accounts separately for the ranged/magic impact checks and falling-brick hazard.
Poison applied with a smoke ancient sceptre reduces each healing event to 4 or 8 Hitpoints per player; this is an optional healing-reduction technique, not the baseline equipment setup.
